attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 5 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The page says the two are unknown to the synaxarists and are mentioned, without biographical details, in the Jerusalem Kanonarion; it carries no asterisk and not the sentence «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη η ύπαρξη του Αγίου». No rank is stated for Domentius, so this folder carries no `types`.
